buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider

2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Industry partner should comply all the technical requirements and should provide duly signed and stam ped of Scope of Work, Advance terms and conditions (ATC) and general terms and conditions and General terms and conditions (Annexure-A)(Attached). 2. The lady searcher should be in age group of 21-35 years of age. 3. An office of the service provider must be located in the state of Tricity (Chandigarh, Panchkula & Mohali) as registered office. Documentary evidence to be submitted. 4.100% payment will be made on monthly basis through offline mode after satisfactory completion of job. 5. The contract will be awarded for a period of two years and may be extended further one year on buyer' s discretion the basis of performance during the last year with approval of the competent authority on the same terms and conditions. . 3. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff.
